answer:
An exact finite determinantal formula is
\[
\boxed{\Delta_b=\operatorname{rank}A_S-\operatorname{rank}B_S-\operatorname{rank}A_O+\operatorname{rank}B_O-\operatorname{rank}A_L+\operatorname{rank}B_L,}
\]
with all ranks evaluated after substituting the given vector \(b\), and matrices defined as follows.

Set
\[
N=4g-3,\quad J=\left\lfloor\frac{N-1}{k}\right\rfloor,\quad D=N+J(2g-1),\quad M=D+2g-1,\quad K=M+D,\quad P=M+2D.
\]
Working modulo \(q^N\), put
\[
s=(1-t^{4g+2})^{1/2},\quad v=-t^{2-2g}s,\quad B=1-kt^k\phi_b(t)q^k,
\]
\[
Q_n=t^nq^nB^{-n/k},\qquad R_n=t^nq^nB^{1-n/k}\qquad(0\le n<N).
\]
The columns of the \(N\times N\) matrices \(T_O,T_L\), indexed by \(n\), are respectively \(Q_n\) and \(vR_n\), in the basis \(1,q,\ldots,q^{N-1}\). The columns \(2n,2n+1\) of the \(2N\times2N\) matrix \(T_S\) are
\[
\begin{pmatrix}vQ_n\\-v(t^{-1}+t^k\phi_b'(t)q^k)Q_n\end{pmatrix},\qquad
\begin{pmatrix}0\\R_n\end{pmatrix},
\]
in the ordered basis \((1,0),(0,1),(q,0),(0,q),\ldots\).

Let
\[
\mathcal H_K=\{(m,0):0\le m\le K,\ m\text{ even}\}\cup\{(m,1):2g+1\le m\le K,\ m\text{ odd}\}.
\]
For \(F\in\{O,S,L\}\), let \(d\) be the size of \(T_F\). Define \(A_F\) with rows \((i,e)\), where \(0\le i<d\) and \(-P\le e\le-1\), and columns \((j,m,\epsilon)\), where \(0\le j<d\) and \((m,\epsilon)\in\mathcal H_K\), by
\[
(A_F)_{(i,e),(j,m,\epsilon)}=[t^e]\bigl((T_F)_{ij}(t)t^{-m}s^\epsilon\bigr).
\]
Let \(B_F\) be the submatrix consisting of the rows with \(-P\le e<-M\). This formula applies to every allowed nonzero complex vector \(b\), including vectors with vanishing components.
